headline: President Trump says the United States will not run joint AI projects with China because that would give Beijing secrets it lacks.
score_reason: Event is from 29 Sep 2026, a week before the edition, and MediaNama says it missed it earlier.
importance_line: It sets the US position on AI cooperation with China for people watching AI risk and trade tension, though the hotline shows some contact continues and the account is second-hand from the BBC.
summary: MediaNama, relaying a BBC report, says Trump said in Washington on 29 Sep 2026 that he will not enter any joint venture with China on AI because it would hand Beijing secrets, while he and Xi Jinping agreed to set up an AI incident notification hotline and keep discussing AI risks. His refusal covers joint development and shared governance, not all contact, and the same report says he also announced a voluntary two-page accord signed by six US tech companies and signed an order telling agencies to say "superintelligence".
notes: Read at MediaNama; the original reporter is the BBC (not read). Score 7 to 5, stale.
